cues.en: Instructor: I hope you found my explanation of K nearest neighbor algorithm in the previous video to be intuitive and easy to understand.
cues.zh: 講師：希望上一支 K 最近鄰演算法的說明，讓你覺得直覺、易懂。

cues.en: What we're going to do in this video is see how the K nearest neighbor algorithm is actually fully implemented.
cues.zh: 這部影片要看看 K 最近鄰演算法，實際上如何完整實作。

cues.en: So we're gonna run through the entire algorithm without calling any special machine learning functions or toolboxes or anything.
cues.zh: 不呼叫特殊機器學習函式或工具箱，走過全部演算法。

cues.en: And then of course, at the very end, I will show you how to do all this stuff with one line of code in MATLAB or Python.
cues.zh: 最後當然示範 MATLAB 或 Python 如何一行完成。

cues.en: But I really want you to see that this is a pretty straightforward method that is easy to implement.
cues.zh: 但希望你看到，方法直接、容易實作。

cues.en: Okay, so we start by simulating the data.
cues.zh: 先模擬資料。

cues.en: This is almost exactly the same way that I simulated the data for K means clustering.
cues.zh: 與 K-means 幾乎完全相同。

cues.en: The main difference is that we don't have a a third cluster here, so we're just starting with two clusters.
cues.zh: 主要差別，沒有第三群，只有兩群。

cues.en: And then let's see, so then generate this plot, and here we see team red and team blue and they're a little bit mixed.
cues.zh: 產生圖，看到紅隊與藍隊，有點混合。

cues.en: So this is the kind of result that you would never get with K means clustering.
cues.zh: K-means 不會得到這種結果。

cues.en: You couldn't get this kind of mixture where the red team soldiers are in the blue team's territory and vice versa.
cues.zh: 不會有紅隊士兵在藍隊領土，反之亦然的混合。

cues.en: Okay, so this is a little bit of an aside here.
cues.zh: 先岔題一下。

cues.en: I'm gonna compute an all to all distance matrix.
cues.zh: 計算所有點兩兩距離矩陣。

cues.en: Now these matrices are not actually used in K nearest neighbor algorithm, but they are kind of pretty to look at.
cues.zh: K 最近鄰其實沒用這些矩陣，但很漂亮。

cues.en: And so I thought I would just show it to you.
cues.zh: 所以展示。

cues.en: So I'm computing the Euclidean distance between each possible pair of points.
cues.zh: 計算所有可能點對的歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: So the distance between these two points and these two points and these two points and these two points, every possible pair of points, and I'm computing the distance between them,
cues.zh: 這兩點、那兩點，每個可能配對，計算距離，

cues.en: storing that in a matrix and it looks like this.
cues.zh: 存在矩陣，像這樣。

cues.en: So this is pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 很有意思。

cues.en: You see, it almost looks like a correlation matrix, except that a correlation matrix has ones on the diagonal and a distance matrix, of course has zeros on the diagonal
cues.zh: 幾乎像相關矩陣，但相關矩陣對角是 1，距離矩陣對角當然是 0，

cues.en: because every data point is zero distance away from itself.
cues.zh: 因為每點到自己距離 0。

cues.en: So you see this kind of checkered pattern over here and this shows you that this is cluster one, this is cluster two.
cues.zh: 棋盤模式表示第一群、第二群。

cues.en: So the distances within cluster one are small, the distances within cluster two are small, and the distances between clusters one
cues.zh: 第一群內距離小，第二群內也小，第一群與

cues.en: and clusters two are larger that's why this is red.
cues.zh: 第二群間距離較大，所以紅色。

cues.en: But it's not generally the case. It's not always the case.
cues.zh: 但不總如此。

cues.en: You find also individual points where these distances are really close together.
cues.zh: 也有個別點距離很近。

cues.en: They're really small, even though these are from different groups.
cues.zh: 即使不同群，距離也很小。

cues.en: So that's, you know, like this kind of a situation.
cues.zh: 就是這種情況。

cues.en: These two points are really close to each other, even though they're from two different groups.
cues.zh: 這兩點不同群，卻很近。

cues.en: Okay, so that was just a little bit of an aside.
cues.zh: 這是岔題。

cues.en: Now let's get back to K means clustering.
cues.zh: 回到 K-means 分群。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is generate a new random data point that's here.
cues.zh: 產生這裡一個新的隨機資料點。

cues.en: I just come up with some random number and then we're gonna plot that back on figure one.
cues.zh: 隨意給隨機數，再畫回第一張圖。

cues.en: So here's our new data point, and then the question is, is this guy fighting on on team red or is he fighting on team blue?
cues.zh: 新點該為紅隊還是藍隊作戰？

cues.en: So to find out, we compute the distance between, so the Euclidean distance, but now it's not between each pair of data points,
cues.zh: 計算歐幾里得距離，但不是每對既有點，

cues.en: it's between each data point and our new point here.
cues.zh: 而是各既有點到新點。

cues.en: Okay, so then I'm going to show those distances here.
cues.zh: 顯示距離。

cues.en: So again, this is now the data element index.
cues.zh: 這是資料元素索引。

cues.en: So there's goes up to a hundred because we have a hundred different data points here.
cues.zh: 到 100，因為有 100 個點。

cues.en: And the y axis is the distance to the new point.
cues.zh: Y 軸是到新點的距離。

cues.en: So now if we say, so then we sort these.
cues.zh: 接著排序。

cues.en: So this is going to tell us which data value has as the smallest distance and the next smallest distance and so on.
cues.zh: 告訴我們哪個資料值距離最小、次小等等。

cues.en: So then we find, what did I set K to be here?
cues.zh: K 這裡設多少？

cues.en: Okay, so I set K to be three.
cues.zh: 設為 3。

cues.en: So we find the data indices that have the three smallest values over here, it's gonna be this one, this one, and I guess probably this one.
cues.zh: 找三個最小值的索引，這個、這個，大概這個。

cues.en: Alright, so then, we find, so here I'm just displaying out the group labels of the three closest points.
cues.zh: 這裡列出三個最近點的群組標籤。

cues.en: So looking at this, we know it has to be two.
cues.zh: 看結果，知道必須是 2。

cues.en: And then I'm taking the median and I'll let you think for a moment about why the median is going to give us the right answer, why not the mean.
cues.zh: 取中位數，想想為何它給正確答案，而不用平均值。

cues.en: So the median turns out to be two.
cues.zh: 中位數是 2。

cues.en: So that tells us that we are on group two.
cues.zh: 所以屬第二組。

cues.en: So then let's go back and plot this and I'm plotting in circles.
cues.zh: 回去畫圖，這裡用圓圈。

cues.en: These are the three closest data points or the K closest data points.
cues.zh: 圈出三個，或 K 個最近點。

cues.en: And then I put a red circle on top of this.
cues.zh: 再疊紅圈到這個，

cues.en: The green circle to indicate that he's joining team red.
cues.zh: 綠圈上，表示加入紅隊。

cues.en: Alright, so that shows you the basic algorithm for K means, or sorry, K nearest neighbor classification.
cues.zh: 這是 K-means——抱歉，K 最近鄰分類的基本演算法。

cues.en: I hope you agree that it's a pretty straightforward method.
cues.zh: 希望你同意，很直接。

cues.en: So now at the very end I just wanna show you that you can do all this crazy stuff that we did up here.
cues.zh: 最後示範，上面做的各種事情，

cues.en: You can do all of that with one line.
cues.zh: 都能一行完成。

cues.en: So this is fit, the C is for classification or classifier, and then we have KNN.
cues.zh: fit，其中 C 代表分類或分類器，再加 KNN。

cues.en: So we input the data, the group labels, and the K parameter here.
cues.zh: 輸入資料、群組標籤與 K。

cues.en: So this gives us our model.
cues.zh: 得到模型。

cues.en: This is not the answer right away.
cues.zh: 還不是直接的答案。

cues.en: And then we use the predict function, which you've seen before with logistic regression to predict the new point based on the model that we have.
cues.zh: 再用邏輯斯迴歸見過的 predict，根據模型預測新點。

cues.en: And no surprise that turns out to be group two.
cues.zh: 不意外，是第二組。

cues.en: Okay, so as I mentioned, I'm gonna go through all of the code here.
cues.zh: 如前所述，走過全部程式碼，

cues.en: So you see the algorithm, the basic algorithm for K nearest neighbors.
cues.zh: 讓你看到 K 最近鄰基本演算法。

cues.en: But then in the end, and certainly for you in the future, if you're using KNN, you want to just use the scikit-learn function, K neighbors classifier.
cues.zh: 但最後，以及日後實際使用時，直接用 scikit-learn 的 KNeighborsClassifier。

cues.en: Okay, so the way that I'm simulating the data is basically the same.
cues.zh: 資料模擬基本相同。

cues.en: It's really, really similar to how I simulated the data for K means clustering.
cues.zh: 與 K-means 非常相似。

cues.en: The only difference is that we have two clusters instead of three and yeah that's basically the main difference.
cues.zh: 唯一差別，兩群而非三群。

cues.en: Here you see the two clusters.
cues.zh: 這裡看到兩群。

cues.en: So we have team red and team blue, and you can also see that there's like a little bit of infiltration.
cues.zh: 紅隊與藍隊，有點滲透。

cues.en: This red square here is like behind enemy lines here is infiltrated blue over here.
cues.zh: 紅方塊到了敵後，滲入藍隊。

cues.en: Okay, so I want to take a small aside, there's a little bit of a tangent to compute something called an all to all distance matrix.
cues.zh: 先岔題，計算所有點兩兩距離矩陣。

cues.en: So this is a matrix of Euclidean distances.
cues.zh: 歐幾里得距離矩陣。

cues.en: You can see we're taking the square root of differences squared.
cues.zh: 差值平方後開平方根。

cues.en: So Euclidean distance between all possible pairs of data points.
cues.zh: 全部可能點對的歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: And that's going to give us a matrix of distances and then we can visualize that matrix.
cues.zh: 得到距離矩陣，再視覺化。

cues.en: So it looks like this, looks pretty neat, almost looks like a correlation matrix, but a correlation matrix has ones on the diagonal and the distance matrix has zeros on the diagonal of course,
cues.zh: 像這樣，很漂亮，幾乎像相關矩陣；但相關對角是 1，距離對角是 0，

cues.en: because every data point is zero units away from itself.
cues.zh: 因為每點離自己 0 單位。

cues.en: Now the most striking thing you see about this matrix is that these values are small, and then you have this big block of large values here.
cues.zh: 最顯著的是，這些值小，那裡一大塊值大。

cues.en: Of course it's a symmetric matrix because the distance between point A and point B is the same as the distance between point B and point A.
cues.zh: 當然對稱，A 到 B 等於 B 到 A。

cues.en: Now what these big blocks are referring to is that this is cluster one.
cues.zh: 大區塊的意思，這是第一群。

cues.en: So, these are all close to each other and this is cluster two and these are all close to each other.
cues.zh: 這些彼此近，第二群內也近。

cues.en: And these are the distances between cluster one and cluster two.
cues.zh: 這是第一群與第二群間距離。

cues.en: And of course they're further apart, although not uniformly far apart, right?
cues.zh: 當然較遠，但不是一律很遠。

cues.en: So you get these blue squares in here indicating a pair with small distances and that's reflecting like the fact that
cues.zh: 裡面的藍格表示某些配對距離小，反映

cues.en: these two data points are closer to each other than this data point is to any of these other guys on the red team.
cues.zh: 這兩點比這點到其他紅隊成員更近。

cues.en: All right, so just a little bit of aside distance matrices are pretty interesting to compute and to look at and to think about.
cues.zh: 距離矩陣值得計算、看與思考，只是岔題。

cues.en: Okay, so what we're gonna do now is create a new data point.
cues.zh: 現在建立新資料點。

cues.en: So it's just, I'm just making that with a random number and then we're gonna replot it here with a green circle.
cues.zh: 隨機數產生，再用綠圈畫出。

cues.en: So here's our new data point and the question is, this guy just magically pops into existence and he wants to know which side is he on, which team is he playing for.
cues.zh: 新點突然出現，想知道屬哪邊、為哪隊。

cues.en: So the way he decides is by, according to the KNN algorithm, looking at the distances from all other points to the new guy.
cues.zh: 按 KNN，查看所有其他點到它的距離來決定。

cues.en: So this looks a little bit like the code I just showed you to create the distance matrix, but now it's not between all of the data pairs, it's just from each individual data point
cues.zh: 程式有點像剛才距離矩陣，但不是所有配對，只是各點

cues.en: to the new point here.
cues.zh: 到新點。

cues.en: So this is the distance in X, this is the distance in Y and then here I make a plot of these.
cues.zh: 這是 X 距離、Y 距離，再畫圖。

cues.en: So now this is the data index.
cues.zh: 這是資料索引。

cues.en: We have a hundred data points and the y axis shows the distance from each data point to the new point.
cues.zh: 100 個點，Y 軸各點到新點的距離。

cues.en: So now we're gonna look for the K equals three.
cues.zh: K 等於 3。

cues.en: So we want the three smallest data points here.
cues.zh: 找最小三個資料點。

cues.en: So it's gonna be this one, and I guess maybe this one here.
cues.zh: 這個，大概還有這個。

cues.en: And so the way that gets implemented is basically by sorting the distance vector and then by taking the top three or the smallest three distances.
cues.zh: 實作就是排序距離向量，取前三個、最小三個距離。

cues.en: Okay, and then we just say, I'm using the median here, and you can meditate for a moment on why the median is the right measure of central tendency,
cues.zh: 接著用中位數，想想為什麼是正確的集中趨勢指標，

cues.en: if it's possible to use or appropriate to use the mean or the mode here as well.
cues.zh: 也能用平均值或眾數嗎？適合嗎？

cues.en: Something for you to think about.
cues.zh: 請思考。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have in circles are the three closest data points and where, oh, I see.
cues.zh: 圓圈是三個最近點，喔，原來如此。

cues.en: I don't know if you can see this on your screen, but the third data point is almost overlapping with the green circle.
cues.zh: 不知道你螢幕看不看得到，第三點幾乎與綠圈重疊。

cues.en: So in fact you don't even see that first data point.
cues.zh: 所以甚至看不到那第一個點。

cues.en: Let me scroll up here. So we should be able to see.
cues.zh: 往上，應該能看見。

cues.en: Yeah, so actually this blue square is, we happen to get the green circle, the new data point exactly lying on top of this blue square here.
cues.zh: 藍方塊，綠圈新點剛好幾乎疊在它上面。

cues.en: So that's hidden there.
cues.zh: 所以被藏起來。

cues.en: So anyways, so these are the top three, the closest three data points to the new data point.
cues.zh: 總之，這是距新點最近的三個點。

cues.en: But even though he's sitting right on top of a blue soldier, he's closer to two red soldiers.
cues.zh: 即使坐在藍士兵上面，但在最近鄰中有兩名紅士兵。

cues.en: So, he turns red, this guy turns red, so he belongs to group one.
cues.zh: 所以變紅，屬第一組。

cues.en: Okay, so all of that code just shows you how to implement K nearest neighbor by hand.
cues.zh: 全部程式碼就是示範手動實作。

cues.en: Of course, when you're working on this kind of a problem in practice, it's easier just to call this function once you understand how it works.
cues.zh: 實務上，理解運作後，直接呼叫函式更容易。

cues.en: So we construct this KNN object with K nearest neighbors and we're using Euclidean distance and then we populate the data or this object with the data
cues.zh: 建立 KNN 物件，指定 K 最近鄰與歐幾里得距離，再填入資料，

cues.en: and the actual group labels.
cues.zh: 以及實際群組標籤。

cues.en: And then we use the predict method to input this new point.
cues.zh: 用 predict 方法，輸入新點。

cues.en: So input the new point and that predicts which group we belong to.
cues.zh: 預測屬哪群。

cues.en: Now you won't be surprised to see that this function, K neighbors classifier, that the new data point belongs to group one, which is exactly what we found as well.
cues.zh: 不意外，KNeighborsClassifier 認為新點屬第一組，與我們相同。
